Lou Amundson is 43 years old.

Lou Amundson was born on December 7, 1982.

Lou Amundson is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

Lou Amundson weighed 220 lbs (99 kg) when playing.

Is Lou Amundson in the Hall of Fame?

Lou Amundson is not in the Hall of Fame.

Power Forward.

When did Lou Amundson retire?

Lou Amundson last played in 2016.

What is Lou Amundson's net worth?

Lou Amundson made at least $11,864,489 playing professional basketball.

Lou Amundson made $2,403,000 in 2012.

What did Lou Amundson average?

Lou Amundson averaged 3.7 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 0.4 assists per game.

How many rings does Lou Amundson have?

Lou Amundson won 0 championships.

Lou Amundson attended Monarch in Louisville, Colorado and UNLV.
